title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 2 — Data Quality + Empty States Step 8
problem: Page 2 still leaks long raw numeric precision, uses some unexplained blank placeholders, lacks unified Verified/Partial/Unavailable data-quality states, and does not preserve an already-owned Over/Under lean when explaining a market-unavailable NO BET.
root_cause: The frozen Page-2 components receive mixed raw and display-ready values directly from the runtime, with no single presentation-only normalization and quality-state layer.
patch: Add a presentation-only Step-8 data-quality helper and bind it through the existing selected-event runtime. Format owned numeric values to one decimal, preserve real zero values, emit explicit missing-data reasons, expose Market/Pace/Explosives/Red Zone/Trends quality states, and improve market-unavailable NO BET rationale without changing model/provider/projection/probability/ranking/selection truth.
acceptance: zero remains a real 0.0 rather than missing
blank values render explicit verified-data reasons instead of unexplained em dashes where Step 8 owns the display value
Market, Pace, Explosives, Red Zone, and Trends expose Verified/Partial/Unavailable states
market-unavailable NO BET can explain an already-owned Over/Under lean while still issuing no official bet
